rulings.a: no: net_draw_per100km_corr2p exists in drive_master.csv but it is the wrong outcome: it is (gross discharge - gross charge - 2p offset) / distance (compute_drive_summary_v6.py L1712-1718), a SoC-ledger change and not road load; in a series e-POWER car the generator supplies any extra wheel or auxiliary demand and the SoC controller holds the battery near balance (the study's buffer thesis), so the +2 to +8 % has no physical link to this column and a percentage of a mean near zero is unstable; confirmatory A1 = logged / app-calculated fuel L/100 km as in M769 and M770; gate it and expect 'not supported': counts only; all battery-side outcomes are exploratory with no expected sign
rulings.b: keep +2 to +8 % as an assumed range for fuel, written as the product of two terms: (rolling share of fuel-equivalent wheel energy x wet rolling increment) + (auxiliary kW x hours per 100 km / energy per 100 km); keep the rule that the MDE must be at most half of the 2 % lower end; state the opposite pull (wet drives are slower, so the aerodynamic load is lower); defog and HVAC can exceed 0.3 kW and are a mediator
rulings.c: the gate in front of A1 is sound; add a hard floor of 20 wet-proxy drives on 10 days; G must count the 0.05 primary threshold (section 0 does not give it); thresholds acceptable; wet needs the M729 span rule (over 30 s) to remove washer bursts; dark must exclude wet-proxy drives or carry the wet proxy as a covariate because auto lamps react to rain; matched-pair support is a gate count only, not the estimator
rulings.d: no: allowed wording is 'drives with wiper activity' and 'a precipitation, spray or washing proxy'; never rain, wet road, precipitation or weather effect; the wiper mode (auto versus manual) is unknown
rulings.e: yes, as month fixed effects in the primary (conservative; it matches the matching cells); design_mde uses the within-month proxy variation; G reports the within-month share of the proxy; without-month is a sensitivity, reported and not picked

required_changes: swap the A1 outcome to fuel; move net_draw_corr2p, gross discharge and regeneration share to A2, kWh per 100 km only, no percentages
add the 20 drives / 10 days floor to G
state the wet-proxy count at the 0.05 threshold in section 0
span rule for the wiper shares; source codes 6 and 7 as a sensitivity
the dark contrast excludes wet-proxy drives
misclassification (wet road without wipers) biases toward the null: state it
risks: about 6 wet-proxy fuel-basis drives: A1 counts only, almost certain
short drives inflate per-100 km values
